-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #17 - Function Synopsis_Tartaros3
function Synopsis_Tartaros3()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("icecrystal13X.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 20011, 500.00, 462.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("Synopsis_Town3_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	FadeIn(100)
	wait(3000)
	Dialogue(6)
	wait(26000)
	FadeOut(100)
	wait(10000)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Synopsis_Tartaros3)
